+ : addition binaire avec retenue ; ce q: +: binary addition with carry; whatever goes past the width is lost (overflow).
<< : décale les bits vers la gauche de B: <<: shifts the bits B places to the left (multiplies by 2 for each place); bits that fall out are lost.
>> : décale vers la droite en recopiant: >>: shifts right, copying the sign bit (division by 2 that keeps the sign).
>>> : décale vers la droite en faisant e: >>>: shifts right, bringing in 0s (unsigned division by 2).
AND : le bit vaut 1 seulement si les deu: AND: the bit is 1 only if both bits are 1. Used to keep some bits (a mask).
AND avec le masque : tout s'efface sauf: AND with the mask: everything is cleared except bit n. The result is 0 if the bit is off, something else if it is on.
AND avec le masque inversé (tout à 1 sau: AND with the inverted mask (all 1s except bit n): that bit becomes 0, the others stay (x AND 1 = x).
